description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'RequestResponseEndpoint' for implementing AMQP request-response endpoints in a service-oriented architecture, handling link management, request processing, authorization, and response delivery, specifically for use with Vert.x and Proton AMQP libraries.

classes.name: RequestResponseEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for implementing AMQP request-response endpoints, managing link setup, message handling, authorization, and response sending in a Vert.x and Proton context.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles link attachment, setting up message handlers and flow control for request reception.

methods.name: handleRequestMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming request messages, including verification, authorization, invocation via event bus, and response delivery.

methods.name: getServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Translates various error types into a ServiceInvocationException with appropriate HTTP error codes.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the client principal is authorized to perform the requested operation, default delegating to authorizationService.

methods.name: extractResponse
methods.description: Extracts an EventBusMessage response from a Vert.x event bus message.

methods.name: filterResponse
methods.description: Allows subclasses to filter or modify responses before sending; default returns the response unchanged.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles establishment of sender links for responses, including validation and registration.

methods.name: onConnectionClosed
methods.description: Cleans up resources when a connection closes, deallocating senders.

methods.name: getSenderForConnection
methods.description: Retrieves or fails if no suitable sender link exists for the given connection and reply-to address.

methods.name: registerSenderForReplyTo
methods.description: Associates a ProtonSender with a reply-to address.

methods.name: unregisterSenderForReplyTo
methods.description: Removes the association of a ProtonSender with a reply-to address.

methods.name: deallocateAllSendersForConnection
methods.description: Removes all sender links associated with a specific connection.

methods.name: flowCreditToRequestor
methods.description: Replenishes flow credits on the receiver link.

methods.name: isValidReplyToAddress
methods.description: Validates the format of reply-to addresses; default checks for minimum segments in the resource path.
